children: Infosys has entered a strategic partnership with Chainlink to standardize adoption of the Chainlink platform across its institutional client base. The arrangement covers CCIP, the Chainlink Runtime Environment, the Automated Compliance Engine, Proof of Reserve, Data Streams, and Data Feeds, with the goal of connecting large financial institutions to onchain markets through a common integration path.

The mechanism is standardization rather than a single product deployment. Infosys, as a large systems integrator, can route bank and capital markets clients to the full Chainlink suite through one defined adoption pattern, which reduces per-institution integration work across CCIP, compliance tooling, and market data services.

Adoption metrics from this channel will take time to appear, and the partnership itself does not commit specific institutions or volumes. Investors may nonetheless reassess LINK's institutional finance thesis ahead of measurable usage, since the agreement positions the entire product stack, not one service, as the default entry point for a major integrator's client base.
